intro: Elder Stormbrow is one of the ancient spirits honored during the Lunar Festival, standing by the water near Goldshire. Travelers who seek out this elder pay homage to the ancient traditions and the olden races of Azeroth. In return for showing respect, the elder bestows a small token of remembrance.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
